Create ONE original full-body transparent-background 2D storybook game sprite: Doctor Roshan carefully rubbing her two soapy hands together at upper-waist height. This is a fresh generation of the missing washing pose, one connected character, not floating hands and not a sprite sheet.

Identity and costume: a cheerful small child mermaid with a round face, big warm brown eyes, short soft brown bangs and flowing caramel-brown hair sweeping to her right. One broad pastel rainbow lock runs through the rightward hair, with a tiny cream pearl flower hairclip. Warm peach skin. Ivory short-sleeved little doctor coat with coral-peach collar, cuffs and hem, a small rounded coral heart badge; teal buttoned blouse, purple waistband; a small cream/coral medical pouch at the right hip. Her single continuous gently curved fish tail has pastel iridescent lavender-pink-purple/rainbow scales and ends in one connected two-lobed fish fin sweeping to her right. No legs, feet, separate tails, wing fins, adult anatomy or glamour.

Action and geometry: full head, hair, shoulders, two attached arms, torso and entire curved tail visible, in a front three-quarter view. Both elbows stay close to her sides; her forearms and clearly joined small hands meet just below the chest, gently rubbing a modest cream/mint soap lather. The hands are the readable working focus, away from her face. Her attentive gaze points down toward her own working hands. No medical tool held, no bottle, bandage, patient or other character. No basin/background included: the existing painted shell sink will be reused independently. Keep the head/body/fin silhouette quiet and stable, with generous transparent margins.

Art finish: a genuinely FLAT 2D cel-painted storybook cartoon cutout. Use continuous visible navy/plum ink outlines around hair, face, clothes, forearms and tail; broad solid local-colour fills with only one simple aqua/lavender shadow band. Hair is a few clear brown rounded locks with the same broad pastel rainbow lock, without fine strands or glossy highlights. Eyes use flat brown shapes, a simple drawn dark upper contour and one tiny white dot highlight, not spherical glass. Nose and closed smile are small simple drawn marks. Skin has a calm flat peach fill, not modelled skin shading. Preserve the original costume description, connected small child body, hands-washing action and single curved tail. The fin must be a modest two-lobed tail tip, visibly smaller than the torso, not an enormous butterfly-like fin. Scales are subtle simplified painted shapes, not sparkling/glittering or reflective material. Cream/mint foam is matte with a clear plum contour and two flat tones. Absolutely no soft 3D rendering, realistic skin/hands, photo modelling, ambient glow/halo, gradient shadow plate, glitter, refraction, texture noise, fur, soft edge fog or background. Make a clean outlined cartoon game sprite at actual transparent RGBA alpha, with generous completely transparent margins on every side. One complete character only; no sink, patient, tool in hands, extra limbs, lettering or UI.
